exp01_control.hypothesis: Control: the original Kaggle recipe (yolov8n, AdamW lr0 0.002, batch 8, patience 20) at the dataset's native 512 px, trained locally so later runs compare like-for-like.

exp02_oversample8.hypothesis: Positives are 25/382 train images (6.5%). Repeating each positive image 8x in the training list (25 -> 200 sampled positives per epoch, dataset files untouched) should raise confidence on unseen poses of the note.

exp03_aug_geo_light.hypothesis: Light rotation/perspective/value augmentation should help with tilted handheld notes without destroying the security features.

exp04_yolov8s.hypothesis: A larger backbone may separate ₹50 notes from look-alike notes better at the same input size.

exp05_imgsz640.hypothesis: Training and exporting at 640 px preserves more fine detail; compare accuracy against the ~2x inference cost.

exp01_control_seed1.hypothesis: Seed repeat of the control to estimate run-to-run noise before trusting small differences.

exp02_oversample8_seed1.hypothesis: Seed repeat of the oversampling experiment to check that the gain is larger than noise.
